report.real_ticks_evidence_scope: HTML header claim only; journal fallback checks required separately

static_excluding_largest_trade.method: Static deletion of one largest positive net trade; other recorded trades unchanged
static_excluding_largest_trade.limitation: Does not resimulate equity, lot sizing, path dependence or TP execution

audit.pairing_method: Strict chronological single open entry, exact symbol/volume, opposite-side full exit; entry order ID supplies original SL/TP

definitions.net: Entry and exit profit + commission + swap
definitions.implied_initial_r_price: Signed entry-to-exit price movement divided by original entry-order SL distance; excludes cash costs and FX conversion
definitions.weekend_flag_calendar_heuristic: Holding interval touches Saturday/Sunday in report timestamps; broker timezone/session not established
definitions.tp_overshoot_price: Positive signed exit-price distance beyond original TP; not a simulated TP cap
